title: (Senior) Account Executive (w/m/d)
description: Wir digitalisieren die Bauindustrie. Bist du dabei? Bei VESTIGAS baust du an der digitalen Grundlage der Bau-Lieferkette: Wir machen aus Bestellungen, Lieferscheinen und Rechnungen eine digitale, rechtssichere Plattform, die im Alltag von Bauunternehmen und Lieferanten genutzt wird. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echter Marktdurchdringung in einem riesigen DACH-Mittelstandsmarkt, lieferst Ergebnisse iterativ und übernimmst Ownership für Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren müssen und nicht nur im Konzept. Deine Rolle Als Account Executive (w/m/d) bei VESTIGAS verantwortest du qualifizierte Leads über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg – von der ersten Präsentation unserer Lösung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Je nach Erfahrung, Dealgröße und Komplexität führst du eigenständig schnelle Abschlüsse oder steuerst anspruchsvollere Sales-Prozesse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Sales oder den Foundern. Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen, berätst lösungsorientiert und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert und datengetrieben, pflegst Deals und Aktivitäten zuverlässig in HubSpot und nutzt Forecasts sowie KPIs als Grundlage für Transparenz und Planbarkeit. Die Herausforderung Unsere Kund:innen entscheiden sehr wirtschaftlich – umso wichtiger ist es, den Nutzen unserer Plattform in klare, nachvollziehbare Zahlen zu übersetzen: weniger manueller Aufwand, weniger rechtliches Risiko, messbare Kostenersparnis. Ein SaaS-Abo folgt dabei einer anderen Logik als eine klassische Investitionsentscheidung, und du hilfst dabei, diesen Mehrwert verständlich zu machen. Weil Dealgröße und Komplexität von Fall zu Fall variieren, wechselst du zwischen schnellem Abschluss und mehrstufigem Prozess – und sorgst trotzdem für verlässliches Forecasting. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst qualifizierte Leads vom BDR-Team und führst passgenaue Demos für unterschiedliche Stakeholder – vom Einkauf bis zur Geschäftsführung. Du managst diese unterschiedlichen Stakeholder über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten eingebunden bleiben und an einem Strang ziehen. Du baust Vertrauen auf, indem du Erfahrungen unserer Referenzkund:innen teilst – darunter 14 der Top-20-Bauunternehmen Deutschlands – da persönliche Beziehungen und Referenzen in der Baubranche besonders viel zählen. Du verhandelst Konditionen und Verträge – eigenständig oder mit dem Head of Sales – und behältst dabei die rechtssichere Dokumentenverarbeitung als zentrales Verkaufsargument im Blick. Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss übergibst du strukturiert an Customer Success, damit der Start für neue Kund:innen reibungslos verläuft. Du nutzt AI-Tools wie Copilot, Claude und Cursor, um Angebote und Präsentationen effizienter vorzubereiten. Dein Profil Du hast bereits Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb und einen überzeugenden Track Record als Account Executive. Du bringst Erfahrung aus einem Startup- oder Scale-up-Umfeld mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Bereich oder mit Bezug zur Bauindustrie. Du schließt Deals unterschiedlicher Größe selbstständig ab, von schnellen Abschlüssen bis zu anspruchsvollen Projekten. Du arbeitest sehr strukturiert und sauber, nutzt HubSpot oder vergleichbare CRM-Systeme exzellent und überzeugst durch klare, lösungsorientierte Kommunikation. Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch fließend. Du lebst in oder in der Nähe von München und bist bereit, 2-3 Tage pro Woche im Büro präsent zu sein. Deine Benefits Echte Verantwortung statt Mikromanagement. Du gestaltest mit, du entscheidest mit, du siehst den Impact deiner Arbeit direkt im Markt. Direkter Draht zu Foundern und Leadership. Flache Hierarchien sind bei uns Alltag. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. AI-First-Workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor und Co. sind bei uns selbstverständliches Werkzeug. Wir erwarten und unterstützen ihren Einsatz. Hybrides Arbeiten mit Office im Herzen Münchens, unweit der Theresienwiese. Flexibles Modell mit regelmäßiger Office-Präsenz, weil wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen auch im persönlichen Austausch entstehen. Wellpass oder BahnCard, Corporate Benefits, Team-Events, jährliche Offsites. Faire, wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager Recruiting & Employer Branding (m/f/d)
description: Intro Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 480 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet. Du bist ein Talent-Experte und weißt, wie eine Arbeitgebermarke repräsentativ zu etablieren ist und die besten Talente zu gewinnen sind? In unserem People-Team bist Du für den gesamten Rekrutierungsprozess der Sanoptis-Gruppe verantwortlich. Du steuerst die Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen in 6 europäischen Ländern (DACH, Spanien, Italien, Griechenland). Du entwickelst und etablierst Best Practices, um die Standardisierung zu erhöhen und Synergien innerhalb unseres Netzwerks zu nutzen. Gemeinsam mit uns etablierst Du Sanoptis als den Employer-of-Choice am Markt. Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf 18 Monate befristet. In dieser Rolle wirst Du Unsere Recruiting-Prozesse entwerfen und steuern : Du trägst die Verantwortung für alle Rekrutierungsaktivitäten der Sanoptis-Gruppe, einschließlich Stellenbeschreibungen, Kanalplanung, Active Sourcing, Bewerberauswahl und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen. Unsere Metriken im Blick behalten und auswerten : Du wirst unsere KPI-Dashboards zur Überwachung der Leistung von Rekrutierungsaktivitäten steuern, auswerten und daraus Daten und evidenzbasierte Handlungen ableiten. Unsere Recruitment-Partner intern und extern steuern : Du wirst Partner wie Stellenportale, Headhunter oder Personalagenturen steuern, Verträge prüfen und Preise verhandeln, um uns stets den besten Zugang zu Talenten zu sichern. Dabei steuerst Du auch Rekrutierungskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam. Zusätzlich schulst Du die Personalverantwortlichen der Kliniken zur Verbesserung ihrer Recruitingaktivitäten. Recruiting mit KI weiterentwickeln : Du beobachtest relevante KI-Trends und nutzt Claude gezielt, um Recruiting-Prozesse zu automatisieren und zu optimieren sowie KI-basierte Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben. Unsere Employer-Brand-Strategie umsetzen : Du stärkst die Sanoptis Employer Brand und entwickelst unsere Außenauftrittem, insbesondere auf LinkedIn, kununu und weiteren relevanten Plattformen, kontinuierlich weiter. Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit Der Head of People Angelina Budes als Deine Führungskraft. Dem globalen People-Team, welches in Recruiting, L&D und People Business Partnering unterteilt ist. Entscheidungsträgern wie Head-ofs, C-Level Executives und Hiring Managern, wenn es um die Einstellung der besten Talente geht. Vielen weiteren Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen durch Hiring-Prozesse, Trainings und weitere Recruiting-Maßnahmen, die Du leitest. Dein Profil überzeugt durch Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting oder Personalwesen. Erfahrung im internationalen Stakeholder-Management. Idealerweise hast Du bereits in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet. Affinität zu KI-Anwendungen , insbesondere Claude; praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Recruiting-Prozessen und -Projekten ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit ATS-Systemen (z.B. Personio). Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und strategische Fähigkeiten und idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement. Emotionale Intelligenz sowie hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau . Sanoptis bietet Dir Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung : Ein äußerst wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Ziele gebunden ist. Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und sich mit innovativen Ideen einzubringen, dank flacher Hierarchien und kurzer Entscheidungswege, was unsere Organisation stärkt. Berufliche Entwicklung: Nutze die Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Lernen und Wachstum durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen. Inklusive Kultur: Arbeite in einem talentierten und vielfältigen Team mit einer herzlichen Bürokultur und Teamveranstaltungen. Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits. Flexible steuerfreie Benefits : Ein individuelles Benefit-Budget von monatlich 50 €, welches nach persönlichen Bedürfnissen gestaltet und steuerfrei genutzt werden kann. Gleiche Chancen Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle. description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>We need a hands-on CapEx procurement expert, not a generalist. You'll lead strategic sourcing for capital investments across HelloFresh's European production sites: machinery, automated lines, Material Handling Equipment (MHE), and facility build-outs. You'll be embedded with Engineering and Operations from spec to handover, owning multi-million euro decisions. This role reports to the Director Indirect Procurement.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for an ambitious, confident, entrepreneurial, and high-spirited Procurement professional with a strength for data processing, optimisation &amp; reporting, ability to navigate ambiguity, attention to detail and great stakeholder management ability.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end CapEx sourcing: supplier market mapping, RFx execution, negotiation, and contract award for high-value capital projects</li> <li>Develop a multi-year CapEx category strategy covering production machinery, conveyors &amp; MHE, cold storage, and building fit-outs</li> <li>Lead Total Cost of Ownership modelling and investment scenario analysis with Engineering and Finance</li> <li>Drive Early Supplier Involvement (ESI) to influence specs and design-to-cost outcomes before projects are locked</li> <li>Build and manage the supplier portfolio across Hello Fresh’s markets: qualification, performance tracking, and continuous improvement</li> <li>Partner with Project Management and Site Operations from inception through commissioning — not just at the buying stage</li> <li>Monitor equipment markets, supplier landscape, and technology trends relevant to food production and logistics</li> <li>Support broader Procurement Ops team, if necessary, in MRO, Facilities Management, Utilities, etc. projects.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>6+ years in procurement, with at least 3–4 years of dedicated CapEx category ownership</li> <li>Proven track record sourcing capital equipment: production machinery, automated systems, conveyors/MHE, or equivalent industrial CapEx</li> <li>Engineering degree or equivalent technical background strongly preferred: you need to speak your stakeholders' language</li> <li>Experience managing large-scale sourcing across multiple European markets</li> <li>Fluent in English; Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delinea’s leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle – across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities – including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines – assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Commercial Account Executive Summary:

This position requires a motivated self-starter who will be responsible for all net new sales into a geographic territory for Commercial Accounts, as defined by Delinea based on annual revenue of $500M or less.

Travel may be required to visit customers, attend trade shows or field events, and for internal meetings such as sales kick-offs or quarterly business reviews. With our strong promote-from-within philosophy, successful performance in this role will provide career advancement opportunities to those seeking to take their sales careers to the next level.

 

This position to be based in Italy.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Create and personalize a territory plan for the assigned territory.

  • Prospect to and create contacts within Commercial Accounts in a geographic region.

  • Proactively pursue existing leads who have expressed interest in our services.

  • Collaborate with and engage the right Delinea technical experts to provide an accurate and compelling story on our products’ strengths and capabilities to win deals.

  • Consistently meet/exceed sales targets.

  • Maintain an accurate forecast of sales pipeline.

  • Cultivate and manage relationships with Channel partners.

  • Never stop learning! Continue to hone your craft and build your expertise in Cybersecurity.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2-5 years as a Commercial software sales executive selling to companies with revenues up to $500M.

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university preferred or equivalent work experience.

  • Track record of success in identifying, cultivating and closing five-to-six-figure transactions.

  • Established book of business in territory, a plus.

  • Ability to conduct both executive level presentations and high-level technical presentations.

  • Experience selling cybersecurity solutions preferred.

  • Excellent written and oral presentation skills. Examples may be requested.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.

title: Technical Product Manager
description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it. This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against. Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery. Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back. Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness. Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record. Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears. Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. What you'll need Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers. Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify. Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control). AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all. Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience. Outcomes Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description: ABOUT US METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production. And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production. And we take it further! READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes. This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business. Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions. Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured. Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation. Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured. Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting. Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation. Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data. YOUR PROFILE 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics WHY JOIN US? raw.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities

raw.title: SCADA Engineering Manager (m/f/d) – Utility Scale PV & BESS
raw.description:
Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery
  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers
  • Testing & commissioning oversight for SCADA, PPC and communication systems
  • Engineering & project coordination across the full plant lifecycle


Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Several years of professional experience in SCADA, industrial automation, power plant control, renewable energy, or grid integration
  • Experience with utility-scale PV, BESS, substations, or other power generation assets highly desirable
  • Good understanding of SCADA architectures, industrial communication networks, and plant control systems
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA or comparable
  • Understanding of active power, reactive power, voltage and grid control concepts is an advantage
  • Experience working with grid operators, utilities, or grid compliance requirements highly desirable
  • Proven track record coordinating external technical suppliers and managing complex system interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and communication systems
  • Confident communicator with engineers, customers, suppliers and grid operators
  • Structured working style and a strong ownership mentality — you drive technical topics until resolved
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites, suppliers or customers
  • Driving licence category B
  • Fluent English; German language skills strongly preferred
  • A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented approach to work, with the ability to apply professional expertise effectively in day-to-day activities
  • A commitment to respectful, trusting collaboration and mutual support within the team


What we offer

 

  • Work in a growing, international company with a start-up mindset
  • A workplace in a central location in Saarbrücken with good transport links
  • An open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Flexitime scheme with core working hours
  • Company sports programme (Hansefit)
  • Subsidised parking in the city centre or a travel allowance for public transport

Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten. Zusätzliche Vorteile: Individuelle Weiterbildung, Mobilitätszuschüsse. Vergütung: Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung mit leistungsbezogener Komponente, Entwicklungsperspektive und Beteiligung an geworbenen Mandaten. raw.title: Senior Ground Software Engineer
raw.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop ground software used for mission preparation, execution, and monitoring of hypersonic systems. 

  • Build robust, user facing applications for Linux and Windows environments that support operators and engineers during real missions. 

  • Implement high performance C++ software with a focus on reliability, usability, and maintainability. 

  • Develop intuitive user interfaces and workflows to visualise system state, mission data, and operational status. 

  • Integrate ground software with simulation, test, and live system interfaces to support end to end operations. 

  • Work closely with systems, GNC, test, and operations teams to translate mission needs into effective software tools. 

  • Where useful, leverage UI frameworks (e.g. Qt) and mapping or visualisation SDKs to accelerate development. 


Who you are

  • A Senior software engineer with 5+ years’ experience building ground or operator-facing software in aerospace, defence, or complex technical domains. 

  • Comfortable developing user-facing applications on Linux and Windows, with an understanding of operational reliability. 

  • Fluent in modern C++, with an instinct for performance, robustness, and clean architecture. 

  • Someone who cares deeply about operator experience, clarity, and usability in high-pressure environments. 

  • Experienced translating mission and system needs into practical software tools, not just features. 

  • Pragmatic about tooling, with exposure to UI frameworks such as Qt and an interest in visualisation or mapping technologies. 

  • Able to move quickly in a startup environment, balancing polish with delivery speed. 

  • Motivated by building software that operators trust during real missions, not demo-only systems. 


What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Image Quality Support (IQS) makes sure Planet's imagery meets that bar. We sit between imaging operations, satellite operations, software engineering, and the business — close enough to engineering to build our own tools, close enough to customers to know what "quality" means to them.</p> <p>We're looking for a Satellite Data Processing Engineer to help assess and automate imagery quality across Planet's satellite fleet. You'll split your time between hands-on visual QA and writing the software that scales it — a hybrid of remote-sensing know-how and software engineering, building up both with guidance from senior teammates.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assess satellite imagery, manually and via automated tooling, against contractual and technical quality standards.</li> <li>Help build and maintain the internal tools that power quality assessment — from QGIS-based QA tooling to backend scripts and data pipelines.</li> <li>Support investigations into customer-reported quality disputes, gathering technical evidence for the team's decisions.</li> <li>Contribute to the team's automated quality-assessment systems, helping shift routine checks from manual review into automation.</li> <li>Write clear reports and tickets that other engineering teams can act on.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of relevant experience.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in geoinformatics, geomatics, remote sensing, or a closely related field.</li> <li>A working understanding of optical remote sensing fundamentals.</li> <li>Solid Python skills: comfortable with version control, code review, and writing more than one-off scripts.</li> <li>Exposure to QGIS or Python geospatial libraries (e.g. GDAL, rasterio, shapely).</li> <li>Basic SQL / database familiarity.</li> <li>Clear written communication: you can explain a technical finding to a non-specialist.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Linux comfort.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI).</li> <li>Any exposure to desktop GUI development (e.g. PySide6/Qt) or building small internal tools end-to-end.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Wellness Program&nbsp;</li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Germany Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€38.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€47.500 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging.&nbsp;<br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.&nbsp; If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!&nbsp; At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.&nbsp; We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.&nbsp; We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. title: Senior Creative Producer (Fixed-term Employment)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt is a Finnish technology company known for its local commerce platform. From food delivery to grocery stores and cosmetics, we make cities better places to live by connecting people with the things they need. Our Global Creative Production team is currently undergoing a massive transformation, shifting from a reactive service center to an "upstream AI-Enabled growth engine".</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Creative Producer </strong>to join us at this pivotal moment.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>This is a 6-month fixed contract opportunity starting ASAP.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: Helsinki, Berlin, Athens, Stockholm, Copenhagen&nbsp;</strong></p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As the Senior Creative Producer, you will manage digital projects from brief to final delivery. You’ll thrive in cross-functional collaboration across different business departments such as B2B, Communication, New Verticals, and Wolt+ teams. You’ll own project timelines for successful deliveries,&nbsp; weekly standups, daily communication with stakeholders and creative teams, and the localization and QA process during the production of social and digital assets.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will own the end-to-end production of digital advertising projects, ensuring our creative assets are not only on-brand but also built for massive scale across global markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day organization of the team and daily communication from brief to delivery.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Day-to-day in this role, you’ll:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End Delivery:</strong> Manage digital projects and multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch. Our deliverables touch social, in-app, DOOH, event collateral, and OOH.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Resource &amp; Budget Control:</strong> Oversee project costs, timelines, and team allocations without losing creative quality.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Align internal marketing teams, designers, and external agencies on project milestones and timelines. Daily and/or weekly status updates are crucial for the success of our projects.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Time Management &amp; Multitasking</strong>: Excellent time management skills with the ability to set priorities, multitask, and meet deadlines. Our producers are working on multiple projects simultaneously, and projects might touch different surfaces each time.</li> </ul> <h2>Our humble expectations&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Solid Production Experience:</strong> 8+ years in creative production or integrated campaign management, ideally within a high-growth tech environment or a progressive digital agency.</li> <li><strong>Understanding of Media Plans</strong>: You have experience with specs and asset production across Awareness, Consideration, and Conversion layers.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Ability to manage complex projects with multiple high-level stakeholders while maintaining high creative standards. Demonstrated success partnering with distributed teams across time zones and cultures</li> <li><strong>Risk Management &amp; Reporting</strong>: Ability to assess risks during production, find solutions, and share with management and stakeholders in a timely manner.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Organizational skills</strong>: Methodical in following a predetermined system to complete tasks and meticulous in paying close attention to small details without losing sight of the big picture.</li> <li><strong>Strong work ethic and accountability</strong>: A proactive attitude and rigor on everyday tasks, a positive mindset despite ongoing changes, and an excitement to learn. Resourceful during productions; deciding and acting on whether to bring external and/or internal resources and self-motivated to lead the project to completion. Someone who doesn’t shy away from a challenge and follows through on commitments made.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Tech-Forward Mindset:</strong> You have a strong interest (and ideally experience) in AI-powered creative tools and generative workflows.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Shape the Future:</strong> You won’t just be filling a seat; you’ll be building the blueprint for how Wolt produces creative content for years to come.</li> <li><strong>Innovation at Scale:</strong> Work at the forefront of AI and automation in the creative industry, moving from manual tasks to agentic workflows.</li> <li><strong>Impact:</strong> Take ownership of strategic business priorities and see your work scale globally.</li> <li><strong>Wolt Culture:</strong> Join a team that values ownership, heart, and a "get things done" attitude in a hybrid, flexible work environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Application Review:</strong> Our Production team will review your profile to see if your experience aligns with our strategy.</li> <li><strong>TA Screen:</strong> A 30-minute introductory call to discuss your background and motivations.</li> <li><strong>Hiring Manager Interview:</strong> A deep dive into your production philosophy with our Creative Production Lead.</li> <li><strong>Loop: Competency &amp; Operating Principles: </strong>a structured behavioural interview with the team.</li> <li><strong>Working Session:</strong> a short case study and walk us through your thinking.<br><br><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="720" height="404"></iframe></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Remote</strong></h2> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.<br><br><span class="discussion-id-2f7cb4da-dab4-8068-a80f-001c50b2d808 suggestion-update notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.</span><br><br>We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!</span></div></div><h2>What this job can offer you</h2> <p>As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.</p> <p>The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.</p> <p>As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Offboarding</h3> <ul> <li>Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.</li> <li>Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.</li> <li>Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.</li> <li>Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.</li> <li>Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.</li> <li>Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.</li> <li>Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.</li> <li>Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.</li> <li>Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.</li> <li>Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.</li> <li>Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.</li> <li>Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.</li> <li>Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.</li> </ul> <h2>Key Requirements and Charactristics</h2> <ul> <li>Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.</li> <li>Proven experience with a strong background in managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR support and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.</li> <li>Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, undertake research, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.</li> <li>Basic understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.</li> <li>Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.</li> <li>Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.</li> <li>Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.</li> <li>Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.</li> <li>Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.</li> <li>Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.</strong></li> </ul> <h2>Practicals</h2> <ul> <li><strong>You'll report to: </strong>Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions</li> <li><strong>Team: </strong>Lifecycle, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions</li> <li><strong>Location</strong>: EMEA</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Application process</strong></h2> <ol> <li>Interview with recruiter</li> <li>Take Home Exercise</li> <li>Interview with future manager</li> <li>Interview with team members (no managers present)</li> <li>Interview with Senior Manager</li> <li>Bar Raiser</li> <li><a href="https://www.notion.so/Veremark-Remote-96e108c037b8423cbd4c3f07a1f9b38b?pvs=21">Prior employment verification check</a></li> </ol> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Remote's <a href="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/people-Total-Rewards-1945bce8d3924ece9421ba8630f57b0c">Total Rewards philosophy</a> is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair <span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-1691622878">equity</span><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-f2a82bc4-09e4-4a71-ad93-755b1d26a690 notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="3"> pay </span>along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.</p> <p>At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce.&nbsp; We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.<br><br>Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.<br><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards &amp; People Enablement team on a case by case basis.</em></p></div><div class="title">The annual salary range for this full-time position is</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$46,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$104,650 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Benefits</strong></h2> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our full benefits &amp; perks are explained in our handbook at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://remote.com/r/benefits" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://remote.com/r/benefits" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote.com/r/benefits</a>. IT equipment</span></li> </ul> </div> <h2><strong>How you’ll plan your day (and life)</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). title: Master Data Management Lead (gn)
description: <p><span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW104639616 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW104639616 BCX0"><strong data-start="240" data-end="250">Start:</strong> 01.01.2027&nbsp;| Level: Lead | Location: Germany, remote | Working hours: Fulltime (40h/week)<br><br>As<strong> </strong>Master Data Management Lead, you will bear overall strategic responsibility for master data management across the entire company. In this role, you will define the governance structure, set priorities for MDM initiatives, and ensure that data ownership, decision-making rights, and processes are clearly established. You will act as the central interface between business strategy and operational data.<br><br>The role can be performed remotely from anywhere within Germany, with occasional visits to our headquarters in Hamburg (approximately once per month during the first year, with less frequent visits possible thereafter)<br></span></span></p> <h3><strong>Your mission</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="7,0,0">You are responsible for the global MDM strategy, the roadmap, and the data governance framework, as well as defining clear data responsibilities (Data Ownership)</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,1,0">You will build a central MDM Center of Competence (CoC) within the TQG Group, establish standards, and ensure the internal development of expertise</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,2,0">You will lead the MDM team functionally and disciplinary, and coordinate the Business and Technical Data Stewards</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,3,0">You will design the Master Data Operating Model (MDOM) as well as end-to-end, cross-domain master data processes (Product, Customer, Supplier, Finance, Logistics)</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,4,0">You will act as a bridge to the business units (SCM, Sales, Finance, etc.) and lead strategic governance committees</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,5,0">You will define and monitor MDM metrics (KPIs) using dashboards and drive continuous improvement processes</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,6,0">You will work closely with the MDM data architecture team to optimally translate strategic guidelines into technical solutions</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,6,0">You will actively promote a cultural shift toward active data ownership across the entire organization</li> </ul> <h3>Your experience &amp; skills</h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="10,0,0">You bring at least 7 years of profound professional experience in the field of MDM, data governance, or data-driven transformation projects</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,1,0">Ideally, you possess solid industry expertise in FMCG, food, dietary supplements, or retail</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,2,0">You have proven leadership competence in cross-departmental projects as well as experience in building MDM governance structures in medium-sized companies</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,3,0">You understand end-to-end master data processes (especially Product, Customer, Supplier, and Finance) down to the smallest detail</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,4,0">You have sound knowledge of SAP S/4HANA within the master data context and are familiar with systems such as ERP, PIM (e.g., Akeneo), CRM, WMS, or PLM (e.g., Centric)</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,5,0">You possess practical know-how regarding data models and system integrations</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,6,0">You are characterized by a structured, analytical, and strategic mindset, paired with a documentation quality suitable for top-management level</li> <li data-path-to-node="10,7,0">You convince with strong communication and moderation skills to drive organizational change, and you are fluent in both German and English</li> </ul> <h3>Why choose us?</h3> <p>Being part of our team means joining a high-performing company with a diverse and inclusive culture. In our fast-growing team of over 1,200 employees, we combine our passion for sports nutrition, supplements, and healthy foods with cutting-edge technology, production, and logistics processes. All of this serves one goal: providing our customers with top-quality products to support their healthy and active lifestyle.</p> <p>You can look forward to a strong sense of team spirit, ongoing opportunities for professional growth and responsibility, and an exciting work environment that blends lifestyle and career. With locations in Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen, and Elsdorf, TQG offers diverse career opportunities in areas such as technology, product development, sales, marketing, and logistics. Additionally, you’ll benefit from:</p> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours and remote work options</li> <li>Attractive employee discounts</li> <li>Subsidy for the E-gym Wellpass</li> <li>Workation</li> <li>Corporate benefits</li> <li>28 days vacation/year</li> <li>and much more</li> </ul> <h3>About Us</h3> <p>The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands&nbsp;<strong>ESN&nbsp;</strong>and&nbsp;<strong>More Nutrition&nbsp;</strong>since 2021.</p> <p><strong>ESN&nbsp;</strong>has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017,&nbsp;<strong>More Nutrition</strong>&nbsp;focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.</p> <p>TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life. Its agile company culture and exciting career opportunities make TQG a strong partner not only for customers but also for employees.</p> <p><strong>This is us – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!</strong><br>We look forward to your application! Regardless of gender, age, background, or identity – what matters to us is who you are and what you bring to the table. Join our team and grow with us!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
