comfortable in Linux.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with connection pooling (PgBouncer or similar) in production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Practical experience with logical replication, major-version upgrades, and low-downtime migration techniques.</p> </li> <li> <p>Scripting ability (Bash, Python or GO) and an automation-first mindset.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred); strong incident-management and RCA skills.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Haves</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Operational exposure to ClickHouse, OpenSearch, or Redis/Valkey, Neo4j.</p> </li> <li> <p>Kubernetes fundamentals (our poolers, proxies, and exporters run on EKS).</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Vault, ArgoCD, or GitOps workflows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort using AI coding assistants to accelerate routine analysis and tooling.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Tech Stack</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>AWS • Aurora PostgreSQL • Kubernetes • PgBouncer • Terraform • Ansible • VictoriaMetrics • Vault • Linux</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>(REQ ID: 2960)</strong></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the team:</strong></p> <p>As Senior Account Manager, you'll be a senior individual contributor and a cornerstone of our commercial team. title: Director/Senior Director, Molecular Discovery
description: <p><strong>Your Impact at LILA</strong></p> <p>The Director, Molecular Discovery is responsible for ensuring our autonomous science platform reliably and repeatedly delivers validated small-molecule drug candidates against designated targets at increasing speed. The platform generates and tests hypotheses at superhuman scale, and you ensure that process translates into real, high-quality compounds that advance toward the clinic.</p> <p>This role leans heavily into the AI and computational side of our workflow: you will be accountable for throughput, quality, and the operational health of the discovery engine, working hand-in-hand with AI scientists, computational chemists, and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks, close feedback loops, and continuously improve how the platform performs.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own small molecule discovery programs against assigned targets, from hit identification through lead optimization and candidate nomination.</li> <li>Serve as the accountable leader for discovery output setting and hitting timelines, quality benchmarks, and throughput targets across active programs.</li> <li>Operate as the primary interface between the autonomous science platform and drug discovery decision-making, ensuring that what the platform produces meets the bar for potency, selectivity, ADMET properties, and developability.</li> <li>Collaborate daily with AI/ML, robotics, and software engineering teams to close the loop between computational predictions and experimental results, driving continuous improvement of the platform's predictive accuracy and experimental efficiency.</li> <li>Architect the components of each discovery program end to end, specifying the required assays, building or sourcing the right capabilities, and managing the scientific staff needed to execute. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence. We're looking for a Robotics Engineer to join our growing technical team in London and take ownership of the integration of a new counter-UAS initiative. This role sits at the intersection of robotics, machine learning and systems engineering, and you'll own the integration across all three. You'll prove out the concept, build the prototype, and take it into trials, working closely with product partners and other stakeholders along the way. The role is highly interdisciplinary, so we're less concerned with ticking every box than with finding someone motivated, curious, and willing to learn. Strong communication skills: you can explain technical work clearly and work effectively with external partners and suppliers. Nice to Have A working knowledge of control theory, particularly designing and tuning PID controllers for closed-loop systems. Experience developing and testing systems before committing to hardware, from numerical modelling through to 3D simulation. Familiarity with RF and RF-based sensing, including how RF sensors and sensor arrays work. Accessibility and inclusivity At Augur, our culture is built on radical candor and mutual trust. To solve the complex, physical-world problems our customers face, we need a team that thinks differently. Whether you’re self-taught, have a non-traditional background, or are returning to the workforce, if you have the grit and the experience we’re looking for at Augur, we’d love to hear from you. You will bring rigorous project and cost accounting to the delivery teams: owning capex and cost accounting for your projects, building and maintaining project cost structures, tracking budgets, commitments and actuals, reporting variances with insight, and ensuring each project is accounted for accurately under US GAAP and closed out cleanly at completion. This is a hands-on role that pairs technical accounting depth with genuine business partnering - you will sit alongside project directors, engineers and procurement, not apart from them.

What You Will Be Doing

Project and capex accounting

  • Capex accounting: own end-to-end accounting for assigned capital projects, including construction in progress (CIP/AUC), capitalization assessments under US GAAP (ASC 360), componentization, capitalized interest where applicable (ASC 835-20), and transfer to fixed assets on completion with correct in-service dates and useful lives.

  • Compute and equipment capex: own the accounting for high-value compute and network equipment (GPU fleets and associated infrastructure), including vendor purchase order and financing payment tracking, delivery acceptance and in-service dating, componentization and useful lives, residual value support, and lessor accounting for intra-group equipment leases (ASC 842).

  • Cost accounting: maintain accurate, complete and well-classified project cost records - distinguishing capital from operating expenditure, applying the capitalization policy consistently, and ensuring costs land in the correct entity, project, site and cost category.

  • Project costing: build and own project cost breakdown structures (WBS/cost codes) aligned to contracts, procurement packages and the accounting dimension framework; establish cost baselines and estimates-at-completion (EAC) and keep them current.

  • Accruals and commitments: run monthly cost accruals from contractor applications for payment, certifications and goods receipts; maintain the committed cost position (POs, contracts, change orders) and reconcile committed, accrued and actual spend.

  • Month-end close: deliver project close activities to the group timetable - CIP reconciliations, accrual journals, retention and milestone payment tracking, and balance sheet substantiation for project-related accounts.

Reporting, variance analysis and forecasting

  • Variance reporting: produce monthly project cost reports comparing actuals and EAC against budget and prior forecast; explain variances with root-cause commentary and work with project teams on corrective actions.

  • Forecasting: partner with FP&A and Strategic Finance on capex cashflow forecasting, phasing of spend, and funding drawdown planning for your projects. Provide current capex phasing and estimate-at-completion data into Strategic Finance's monthly business plan refresh.

  • Board and investor reporting: contribute project cost and progress data to board packs, lender/investor reporting and management information, ensuring one version of the truth between delivery and finance. Work within, and help build, the group project reporting framework.

  • Balance sheet visibility: own the project-related balance sheet - CIP, retentions, VAT recoverable, prepayments and committed spend - and feed these positions into the group management balance sheet dashboard on an automated, near-real-time basis.

Project lifecycle and business partnering

  • Cradle to completion: support projects through their full lifecycle - business case and budget setting, contract award, execution, change management, practical completion, final account settlement, and financial close-out including release of retentions and accrual true-ups.

  • Change control: evaluate the cost and accounting impact of scope changes, change orders and claims; ensure changes are approved, coded and forecast before costs are incurred.

  • Business partnering: act as the trusted finance counterpart to project directors, construction managers, procurement and engineering; challenge constructively, translate financial data into decisions, and embed cost discipline in delivery teams.

  • Contract and procurement support: work with procurement and legal on the financial aspects of construction and equipment contracts (payment mechanisms, milestones, retentions, bonds, liquidated damages) and ensure compliance with the Group Procurement Policy and PO controls.

Controls, policy and audit

  • Controls: operate and help design internal controls over project costs, capitalization and payments as part of the group's SOX 404 readiness program, including preparing clear documentation and audit evidence.

  • Policy: apply and help refine group accounting policies (capitalization, PP&E, procurement) and prepare technical accounting analysis for project-specific matters, escalating judgmental issues with well-structured recommendations.

  • Audit: act as the primary project-accounting contact for external audit on assigned projects, preparing schedules, reconciliations and supporting evidence.

  • Anything else that makes sense: as an early hire in a fast-scaling finance function, contribute to systems implementation (ERP selection ongoing), process design, and whatever else is needed to build best-in-class project controllership.

What You Bring

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or equivalent) with strong post-qualification experience.

  • Demonstrable experience of project accounting for large, long-term capital projects - for example data centers, energy, utilities, infrastructure, construction or industrial facilities - covering the full project lifecycle.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of capex and cost accounting: CIP/AUC, capitalization criteria, componentization, accruals from contractor valuations, retentions, and asset transfer at completion.

  • Experience building and managing project cost structures (WBS/cost coding), budgets, committed cost tracking and estimates-at-completion.

  • Strong variance analysis and reporting skills, with the ability to explain cost movements clearly to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Proven business partnering experience embedded with, or working closely alongside, project delivery teams.

  • Advanced Excel and strong data and dashboarding skills, with an automation-first mindset; comfortable working from imperfect data in a scaling environment.

Nice To Have

  • US GAAP experience (ASC 360 fixed assets, ASC 835-20 capitalized interest, ASC 842 leases as they touch project sites).

  • Experience in a SOX-regulated or IPO-readiness environment, or supporting external audits of major capital projects.

  • Exposure to multi-entity, multi-currency structures and cross-border projects.

  • Nordic experience - local statutory reporting alongside US GAAP, and VAT on construction and imports.

  • Experience accounting for high-value technology or compute equipment (GPU, network or telecoms assets), including intra-group equipment leasing.

About The Role

We are hiring our first dedicated Corporate Secretary to own company secretarial and corporate governance matters across the Volta group. As we add entities, boards, joint ventures and financings at pace, we need a professional who can bring order, rigor and forward planning to entity management, board processes and statutory compliance — across the UK and, working with local counsel and providers, in Norway, the US, Luxembourg and Spain.

This is a high-ownership role at the center of live transactions. You will work directly with the SVP Strategic Finance, the founders and senior leadership, and coordinate day to day with top-tier external counsel and corporate service providers. It suits someone who wants breadth, pace and genuine responsibility rather than a narrow, process-only remit.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Entity management — Maintain the group entity map and statutory records for all group companies; manage incorporations, shelf-company acquisitions, re-registrations, and inter-company reorganizations across jurisdictions, working with local counsel and registered agents.

  • Board and shareholder governance — Prepare and manage board and shareholder meetings, written resolutions, minutes, powers of attorney and delegated authority frameworks; maintain resolution logs and ensure signing authorities are current and evidenced.

  • Statutory compliance — Own Companies House and equivalent registry filings (confirmation statements, PSC/RLE registers, director appointments and resignations, share allotments), and monitor filing calendars across all jurisdictions.

  • Transaction support — Support financings, joint ventures and M&A with corporate approvals, condition-precedent deliverables, officer certificates, structure charts, KYC packs and closing mechanics; coordinate signing and completion logistics.

  • JV and investor governance — Administer shareholders' agreements, deeds of adherence, reserved-matter consent processes and information rights for joint venture partners and investors.

  • Banking and counterparty onboarding — Manage KYC/AML documentation, bank mandate resolutions, authorized signatory lists and W-series / entity classification forms for banks, lenders and major suppliers.

  • Director and officer support — Manage director onboarding (including foreign registration requirements such as identification numbers for non-resident directors), D&O compliance, conflicts registers and director training.

  • Policies and records — Build and maintain the corporate governance manual, minute books, share registers, and a single source of truth for constitutional documents and corporate approvals.

  • External providers — Instruct and manage law firms, notaries, and corporate service providers in each jurisdiction; control cost and quality of company secretarial spend.

Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

Our Digital Experience team is growing! We’re looking for a Junior Product Designer to join our team in London.

In this role you will turn conversion ideas into designs we can test. You’ll design landing pages, offer pages, comparison tables and journeys for our experimentation programme, learn from every result and help build the patterns that let us test faster across more brands.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design test variants for landing pages, forms, offer pages and comparison journeys, from CRO hypothesis to developer-ready file

  • Work with CRO, creative and development teams to get experiments live quickly and read what the results tell us

  • Build and maintain reusable components in our Figma design system so new tests and brands launch faster

  • Support the newly acquired rewards brands as they join the experimentation programme

  • Help with qualitative research, from usability sessions to reviewing recordings, to shape better hypotheses

About You

  • A portfolio that shows how you design to get people to take action, from placements, freelance, a course or a first role

  • Confident in Figma, including components and auto layout

  • Curious about conversion: you want to know why one version wins and how to test it

  • Able to take a brief and feedback and move quickly to a clean, considered design

  • Experience in performance marketing, affiliate or lead generation is a bonus, not a requirement

  • You thrive when working as part of a team

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment

  • Have excellent written and verbal English skills

  • Last but not least, you’ll have no ego!

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Bupa)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

  • Market-Leading Training Programme

  • Recognition & Reward Scheme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

What’s the next step?

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

If you like the sound of what we're all about at Quantum and want to join a team where you can make an impact, please apply or contact us at -----

title: Lead Product Designer  (AEX)
description: Lead Product Designer 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 💰 £70k-£90k (negotiable) Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology. We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer - the most senior individual contributor for design within a product domain. This is predominantly an IC role: you'll set the design bar for an entire domain through the quality of your own work, the patterns you contribute, and the way you raise the designers around you. We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk. We want someone who is tired of the "feature factory" grind, who is past needing to be told what's worth working on, and who is ready to set the design direction for a domain in one of the most exciting PropTech companies in the UK. If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you. At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them. Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask. We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping. Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L6 Lead Product Designer at Street Group Own the design vision and execution for a product domain. Translate strategic direction into the most ambiguous, cross-cutting, or strategically important pieces of design work. Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like in your area. Own the cross-cutting design problems: patterns across multiple features, flows across multiple surfaces, the coherence of the domain's experience as a whole. Mentor and raise the bar of the designers around you - through critique, pairing, and modelling what excellent design looks like. Drive AI thinking strategically - both in your own workflow (Claude Code, in-product changes, prototype testing) and in what we ship to users. You'll have a strong view on what makes a good AI feature in this domain vs a gimmicky one. Why you should (and shouldn't) apply You should apply if: You've operated at senior IC level in a modern product org and you want broader scope to influence what gets built. You're commercially fluent. You've made design trade-offs informed by how the product makes money, not just by user preference. You can name those trade-offs and defend them either way. You define what success looks like before you ship, and you read the result against it after. Metrics, support data, customer feedback - you go and look. You have strong, well-formed views on AI in product design and have put them into practice. You can articulate when AI is the right design solution and when it isn't. You move at pace on strategic work, not just on features. You probably shouldn't apply if: You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role. Lead expects materially more scope, autonomy, judgment, and ownership of outcomes. You've never shipped design work where you defined a success measure upfront and checked the result afterwards. We need someone who already operates that way. You've never had to make a commercial trade-off - design that's user-optimal but expensive to build, or design that doesn't move retention. You'd struggle to explain how AI is changing what you ship, not just how you work. AI fluency is non-negotiable at this level. You expect to be handed a brief. At L6 you identify what's worth doing and bring the case for it. A bit about you Experience: Roughly 8+ years of Product/UX Design experience, with a track record at senior IC level. SaaS or complex product experience is strongly preferred. Outcomes, not artefacts: You can point to design work you've shipped where you wrote the success measure upfront and read the result after release. You know what worked, what didn't, and what you'd do differently. Commercial fluency: You understand how the products you've worked on make money and you've made trade-offs informed by that. AI: Comfortable using AI across your workflow and equally comfortable thinking strategically about AI in the products you design - what makes a good AI feature, what the failure modes are, what to build now vs later. Craft: Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. You have views on interaction quality, hierarchy, motion, microcopy - and you can defend them. Cross-functional: Comfortable as a peer at the table with product and engineering counterparts in your domain. Drive direction; don't wait for it. Open to flex: This is predominantly an IC role, but we're not rigid about it. If you've line-managed before, or want to take on one or two direct reports alongside the IC work, we're open to that conversation. Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application. Why join Street Group? 🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week 🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!) 💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth 📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development 🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away 🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us 👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay 🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured 🧘 Regular well-being initiatives 🕒 Flexible working hours 🚂 Public transport season ticket loans 🌷 Paid menopause leave 🌞 Holiday buying scheme 🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition 👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day 👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology 🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome! 🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon 🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours 🚴 Cycle to work scheme 🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme 🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company! Salary We don't have a fixed band published for this role yet - it'll be calibrated based on your experience and scope. Please apply and let's have the conversation. We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified. Interview Process 4 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview inc a design task with our Head of UX > Final interview with our Co-Founder/Head of Product. We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know. A note on using AI in your job application As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. As a Technical Implementation Consultant at Hook, you’ll play a mission critical role in helping customers unlock value fast. Great implementations set the tone for long-term success and you’ll be the one making that happen. From diving into complex datasets to running projects with precision, you’ll guide customers through onboarding and deliver smooth, impactful go-lives that shape their entire journey with Hook. If you love working at the intersection of data, technology, and customer success, and want to see your work make a tangible impact every day, this role is for you. By working closely with our data science team, you’ll help ensure the models perform at their best and deliver valuable insights for our customers. Run projects with precision staying highly organised, structuring your day effectively, and prioritising tasks to keep implementations on track. Meet tight 28-day implementation timelines, balancing speed with quality in every rollout. Provide expert guidance on how to leverage Hook’s features for renewal forecasting, time management, and process automation, helping customers achieve quick wins. Who are we looking for? Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex joins, subqueries, window functions, CTEs and aggregations to wrangle complex datasets and advise customers Customer-facing excellence: you can translate technical detail into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders at all levels. Experience in data consulting, implementation, or customer engineering roles at a data-driven SaaS company. Curiosity and enthusiasm for data, AI, machine learning, and cloud platforms. Proven ability to manage multiple implementations in parallel, with tight timelines. A detail-driven mindset: you thrive working on complex datasets and can spot anomalies others might miss. Salary: £60k - £75k base salary+ OTE (depending on experience) Benefits 🏖️ 27 days holiday (option to buy and sell holiday) + bank holidays 📈 Generous stock options 🏥 Private health insurance so you can get the best care you need 🧘 Flexible monthly wellness allowance that you can use monthly on things like gyms, yoga, mental health & healthy food 📚 Annual learning & development budget for every employee 🏢 Flexible working - we’ll all come together three days a week but otherwise you can work from home or come into our awesome office in Liverpool Street 💻 The best equipment for everyone to work with Our founder and team are incredibly passionate about creating a company culture that is diverse, inclusive, productive and enjoyable for all our colleagues. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description Growth is a critical function at Allica, sitting at the intersection of marketing, product, sales, and data. Our team is responsible for driving sustainable and scalable customer acquisition, engagement, and retention—ensuring our banking solutions reach and resonate with the right SMEs at the right time. Growth is both a science and an art. We blend commercial strategy with deep customer understanding, leveraging data to uncover new opportunities while ensuring every touchpoint aligns with Allica’s mission to empower established SMEs with the banking they deserve. Role Description The Growth Manager will play a key role in driving effective and sustainable growth across Allica's BRA customer journey — from onboarding through account activation and into deeper, embedded product usage. This role focuses on understanding customer behaviour end-to-end, identifying where customers stall or disengage, and building the strategies and capabilities needed to move them forward. Using a data-driven approach, the Growth Manager will lead the design and delivery of initiatives that improve activation, engagement, and long-term customer value — often working with limited precedent and translating diagnosis into tools, frameworks, and ways of working that the wider business relies on. They will build alignment across marketing, product, sales, RM, and data teams, ensuring growth strategy is coherently applied across the customer journey. This role is ideal for someone with strong applied critical thinking, a track record of leading initiatives with real ambiguity, and the ability to build stakeholder alignment without formal authority over the teams they influence. Principal Accountabilities Customer Behaviour & Cohort Analysis: Lead analysis of customer behaviour, lifecycle stages, and cohorts to identify key drivers of activation, engagement, and product usage, delving into complex problems to reach root-cause understanding rather than surface patterns. Data-Driven Insights & Strategic Recommendations: Own the growth and engagement metrics that matter most for the customer journey, translating insight into strategy that shapes how the team and wider business operate. Experimentation & Optimisation: Manage a robust experimentation pipeline, designing, prioritising, and overseeing tests across initiatives to ensure impactful, evidence-based decisions rather than one-off analysis. Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Build alignment across departments; marketing, product, sales, RM, and data, managing differing stakeholder expectations to keep initiatives progressing. Framework & Capability Building: Take diagnosed problems through to operational reality, building the tools, scoring frameworks, and processes that other teams adopt and rely on. Leadership & Ownership: Manage multiple objectives concurrently, ensuring accountability for outcomes even where the path forward isn't well precedented. Communication: Design and deliver insightful, visually compelling presentations that influence decision-making and align stakeholders on growth strategy Personal attributes & Experience Experience working in hypothesis-led, problem-solving environments (e.g. high-growth start-ups, consulting or similar) is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and navigate complex, ambiguous problems using structured thinking. Proven experience conducting complex data and performance analysis, ideally using SQL to work with large datasets. Ability to translate customer and operational insights into clear, actionable changes across products, processes, or messaging. Comfortable working with technical systems and integrations (e.g. CRM, analytics tools, automation platforms) to improve efficiency and scale. High bar for quality while maintaining pace, particularly on work with limited precedent. Strong stakeholder management skills, able to influence and align teams with different priorities through clear, evidence-led recommendations. Bias towards ownership and execution — able to independently drive work forward, frame problems, and recommend solutions with limited direction Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. </span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&amp;P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!</span></p></div><p><strong>About Expert Insights:</strong><br>Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp; </span>delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.</p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <p>As a Sector Lead (Energy &amp; Industrials) on our Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. Reporting to the Director of Research for E&amp;I you will oversee the day-to-day execution of Directed Content projects, ensuring all work meets the firm’s standards for quality, relevance, and, end-user value delivery. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.</p> <p>You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. Your responsibilities will span project setup, expert sourcing guidance, transcript quality assurance, budget oversight, and performance management. Acting as the connective layer between the Director of Research’s strategic vision and day-to-day execution, you will ensure flawless delivery of sector coverage plans while maintaining a pulse on emerging market themes and client information needs.</p> <p>You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp; </span>the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will then translate into a structured execution plan, ensuring coverage aligns with key market and client priorities.</li> <li>Manage and mentor a team of Project Managers that oversee the execution of Directed Content projects, setting clear goals, tracking KPIs, and ensuring accountability across all deliverables.</li> <li>Collaborate with Operations Managers who oversee Analyst execution of expert recruiting, onboarding, and interaction facilitation to align operational KPIs to coverage strategy and optimize execution</li> <li>Own expert budget management for your sector, allocating resources effectively to maximize content ROI while maintaining high quality and throughput.</li> <li>Oversee a structured QA process for ensuring transcripts within your sector of coverage meet the highest standards for data accuracy, relevance, structure, and analytical depth.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research and our Content Strategy Analyst to monitor engagement data, identify coverage gaps, and recalibrate project pipelines accordingly.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research to identify and shape content to support revenue-generating efforts such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.</li> <li>Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future content.</li> <li>Collaborate with North America directed content teams to ensure high quality output and consistency.</li> <li>Partner with Operations and Product teams to pilot and optimize AI-enabled tools that improve project throughput, QA precision, and overall efficiency.</li> <li>Maintain deep familiarity with ongoing developments within the Energy &amp; Industrials sector, proactively surfacing new themes and companies to guide future research focus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5–7 years of experience in equity research, market intelligence, consulting, or a related analytical role within Energy &amp; Industrials (E&amp;I)</li> <li>You bring deep domain expertise in Energy &amp; Industrials (E&amp;I) with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends shaping your space.</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of European and Asian equity markets.</li> <li>You have proven people management experience, successfully leading, mentoring, and developing teams of project managers or analysts.</li> <li>You are skilled at translating strategic objectives into actionable research projects that yield high-impact insights.</li> <li>You possess exceptional organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, able to balance multiple priorities with agility while maintaining high quality standards.</li> <li>You have a strong command of project economics, capable of managing budgets, optimizing expert costs, and tracking ROI to ensure resource efficiency.</li> <li>You are adept at working cross-functionally with Directors of Research, Go-to-Market, Product, and Compliance to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.</li> <li>You are intellectually curious, client-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You maintain a strong understanding of compliance, MNPI, and confidentiality standards across all project types.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. gained initial experience in an agency or client side environment, ideally with exposure to Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), marketing effectiveness, or related marketing analytics.&nbsp;</li> </ul> title: Chef de Projet Paid Media Senior (H/F)
description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Aujourd'hui présents dans plus de 10 marchés, avec une part internationale qui dépasse 50 % des ventes, nous construisons notre croissance avec rigueur, sans sacrifier l'âme de la marque. C'est dans ce contexte que nous cherchons un·e Chef·fe de Projet Paid Media Senior pour renforcer notre équipe média. Intégré·e à l'équipe Média, vous pilotez les campagnes paid social (Meta, Pinterest, TikTok…) et autres canaux sur un périmètre de marchés clés dans le développement international de Sézane. Vous êtes garant·e de la performance de A à Z : cadrage stratégique, mise en place opérationnelle, analyse et restitution des résultats. Vos missions Traduire les enjeux business en stratégie média. Acquisition, retargeting, notoriété, vous construisez les plans d'activation en cohérence avec le calendrier Sézane. Opérer les campagnes avec autonomie et exigence. Vous gérez de bout en bout les activations sur l'ensemble des plateformes sociales, en cherchant toujours le bon équilibre entre performance et cohérence de marque. Analyser, challenger, recommander. CPA, ROAS, COS, LTV, incrémentalité, vous lisez les chiffres avec recul et formulez des recommandations actionnables sur les audiences, créas et enchères. Embarquer les équipes avec des reportings orientés décision. Clairs, concis, au service du pilotage marketing et du management. Être force de proposition sur l'innovation média. Bêtas, nouveaux formats, évolutions des méthodologies de mesure , vous apportez un regard curieux et structuré sur ce qui peut faire avancer notre pratique. Contribuer au mix media global. En lien étroit avec les équipes e-merch, CRM et créa, vous participez à la réflexion sur nos choix d'investissement et nos modèles de mesure. Requirements 5 ans minimum d'expérience en gestion de campagnes paid social, en agence performance ou chez un e-commerçant. Maîtrise opérationnelle des plateformes d'achat media (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok for Business, Pinterest Ads…).  Solides compétences analytiques : à l'aise avec Excel (TCD, formules avancées) et idéalement avec un outil BI (Metabase, Looker, Tableau). Rigueur et autonomie : vous gérez vos priorités, respectez vos délais et alertez au bon moment. Curiosité et appétence pour la marque : vous comprenez que la performance média ne se lit pas sans le contexte produit et la saisonnalité.  Anglais professionnel indispensable (marchés internationaux). Benefits Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un contexte de croissance internationale réelle, avec des marchés aux enjeux différenciés Une équipe média interne, en lien direct avec les équipes e-merch, CRM et créa Des sujets de mesure et de pilotage automatisé ambitieux Une culture du travail fondée sur la confiance, l'autonomie et l'amélioration continue. raw.title: Lead Product Manager - RPG
raw.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line. 

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

Mission

As a Lead Product Manager on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
  • Own LiveOps end-to-end. You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
  • Lead your team. You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
  • Oversee the monetization model. Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
  • Drive growth, in partnership with UA. You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
  • Cross-functional excellence. You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
  • Set the bar. Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
  • Stay hands-on when it counts. This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.

This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG, with genuine end-to-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

Product & RPG expertise

  • Product experience on live F2P mobile games, ideally RPG/midcore, with end-to-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
  • Strong fluency in RPG mechanics and meta systems: progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
  • Ideally, you’ve taken a title from concept/pre-launch through launch and LiveOps, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

LiveOps & Execution

  • Deep LiveOps experience, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
  • Strong track record owning features end-to-end: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of what a live team can realistically ship and maintain, balancing ambition with feasibility.

Leadership & Ways of working

  • Strong cross-functional leadership, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
  • A strategist and builder: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands-on with the game, systems and data.
  • Thrives in lean, fast-moving, high-autonomy teams with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough.”
  • Humility: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we dive deep into the details.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)
description: About the team The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior. This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows. Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work. In this role, you will: Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software. Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption. Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability. Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform. Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value. Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved. Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools. Are an active user of Codex or other AI coding tools, with a thoughtful perspective on how they can improve software development. Are a compelling communicator who enjoys presenting, delivering live demos, and leading hands-on workshops for developers and founders. Have a talent for turning complex technical ideas into clear explanations, engaging examples, and reusable resources that help others succeed. Combine developer empathy with sound technical judgment: you can uncover what a team needs, troubleshoot problems, and help them adopt effective, reliable workflows. Bring high agency, curiosity, and end-to-end ownership, working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues and ecosystem partners. What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

title: Technical Recruiter
description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. About the Role You'll join Vibe's Talent Acquisition team inside the People org, initially reporting directly to Nicholas Wagner, Chief People Officer. The team owns hiring across Vibe as it pushes toward its 2030 growth targets, and this role is being created to give that effort an extra dedicated pair of hands in Paris. You'll get real ownership from day one: full-cycle recruiting on technical roles, direct partnership with hiring managers, and a seat at the table as the team builds. If you want to grow into a senior technical recruiter inside a team that still feels small enough for your work to be visible, this is a good place to do it. What You'll Do Own full-cycle recruiting for Engineering and Product roles, from intake to offer. Build sourcing pipelines for specialized technical profiles, including Data and ML roles. Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements before opening a search. Run structured candidate conversations that give hiring managers real signal. Keep candidates informed and engaged at every stage of the process. Track pipeline health and flag bottlenecks before they slow a search down. Represent Vibe's culture and mission to candidates considering multiple offers. What You Need 3+ years of experience running full-cycle technical recruiting in a fast-growing company. You've built candidate pipelines for specialized or hard-to-fill technical roles. You've managed a hiring process end to end, from outreach through offer. You communicate clearly with both candidates and engineering hiring managers. Nice to Haves Experience recruiting in the streaming TV advertising or connected TV (CTV) space. A network within the Paris or broader European tech ecosystem. Proven experience on Ashby ATS. Our Values At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. What We Offer For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k , plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up: Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it. Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. Meal vouchers — Via Swile. Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. Our Interview Process We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting. raw.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join Vibe's Talent Acquisition team inside the People org, initially reporting directly to Nicholas Wagner, Chief People Officer. The team owns hiring across Vibe as it pushes toward its 2030 growth targets, and this role is being created to give that effort an extra dedicated pair of hands in Paris. You'll get real ownership from day one: full-cycle recruiting on technical roles, direct partnership with hiring managers, and a seat at the table as the team builds. If you want to grow into a senior technical recruiter inside a team that still feels small enough for your work to be visible, this is a good place to do it.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Engineering and Product roles, from intake to offer.

  • Build sourcing pipelines for specialized technical profiles, including Data and ML roles.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements before opening a search.

  • Run structured candidate conversations that give hiring managers real signal.

  • Keep candidates informed and engaged at every stage of the process.

  • Track pipeline health and flag bottlenecks before they slow a search down.

  • Represent Vibe's culture and mission to candidates considering multiple offers.

     

What You Need

  • 3+ years of experience running full-cycle technical recruiting in a fast-growing company.

  • You've built candidate pipelines for specialized or hard-to-fill technical roles.

  • You've managed a hiring process end to end, from outreach through offer.

  • You communicate clearly with both candidates and engineering hiring managers.

     

Nice to Haves

  • Experience recruiting in the streaming TV advertising or connected TV (CTV) space.

  • A network within the Paris or broader European tech ecosystem.

  • Proven experience on Ashby ATS.

     

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

 

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

 

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

     

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  • Live technical discussion — 60 min. A real Vibe search, worked through live with us: search strategy, candidate calibration, pipeline diagnosis. No take-home, no homework.

  • Engineering partner interview — 30 min. A live role intake with one of our engineering leaders.

  • Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  • Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐

You'll join Malt's AI & Automation Team to build the AI & Automation backbone of our commercial organization. Working hand in hand with commercial leadership and reps, you'll design the workflows that keep our CRM sharp, surface the right signal at the right time, and power a highly personalized outreach machine. You'll also be the team's eyes on what's next in AI & automation, testing new ideas with beta users and pushing the ones that work into production.

Key responsibilities ✨

  • Design and build AI & Automation workflows (n8n, Dust, and more) integrating Salesforce, enrichment providers, and other data sources to keep CRM data accurate and complete.

  • Manage and maintain integrations across the commercial tool ecosystem (e.g., Aircall, Modjo, Clay) to ensure seamless data flow and eliminate manual syncs.

  • Detect buying signals (company changes, job moves, funding, market shifts) and route them into commercial workflows so reps act at the right moment.

  • Build and scale a highly personalized outreach engine, using LLMs to tailor messaging for the commercial team at scale.

  • Identify beta testers among the commercial team, run experiments, and iterate quickly based on feedback and data.

  • Track AI & automation trends through ongoing tech watch, and bring back new ideas, tools, and patterns.

  • Implement reliability patterns and document the architecture of the workflows you ship.

  • Partner closely with commercial leadership and reps to prioritize the roadmap and train users on new tools.


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

  • Engineering background: You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering (Bac+5 or equivalent), combining technical rigor with a strong business sensitivity to bridge tech and commercial teams.

  • Automations & Integrations: You have hands-on experience building workflows (n8n, Make, Zapier) and connecting commercial stack tools (Salesforce, Aircall, Modjo, Clay) via native integrations, APIs, or webhooks.

  • AI & Data stack: You are comfortable with the LLM/AI ecosystem (OpenAI API, Dust, LangChain, Mistral) and solid with SQL and scripting (Python/JavaScript) to connect systems end-to-end.

  • Commercial empathy: You understand sales processes and genuinely enjoy working close to commercial teams to remove their daily friction.

  • Languages: You have professional working proficiency in English.


    • How to join the mission? 🚀

  • First call with Alexandre, our Talent Acquisition Manager, to better understand your background, aspirations and answer any questions you may have. (30-45 minutes)

  • A 60-minute session with your future manager, Léo Martin, to explore your background and the role’s specifics. 

  • Live practical case with Léo Martin and another Malter in order to evaluate and discuss technical topics, problem-solving approaches, and ways of working.

  • Final interview with Anaïs to discuss Malt’s long-term vision and how you fit into our strategic growth.

    • Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    - Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other new joiners at our office in Paris
    - Equity: Every Malter is entitled to stock options 
    - Malt sabbatical: Every three years, all Malters are entitled to a one month fully paid sabbatical leave
    - Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow
    - Team building events organized every year
     
    Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 
     
    At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.
     
    Your profile may be subject to background screening. For more information see our candidate privacy policy.
