description: <div class="content-intro"><div style="font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'Segoe UI', Trebuchet MS, Tahoma, sans-serif;"> <p style="line-height: 1.4;">Vast is developing next-generation <strong>space stations and space infrastructure</strong> using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced <strong>Vast Satellite</strong>, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.</p> <p style="line-height: 1.4;">Headquartered in<strong> Long Beach, California</strong>, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.</p> </div></div><p>Vast recherche un(e) <strong>Directeur(trice), Développement Commercial International - Satellites</strong>, sous la responsabilité du <strong>SVP, Satellite Business Development &amp; Commercialization</strong>, pour diriger le développement commercial axé sur le commerce (communications, observation de la Terre, détection, défense et applications de calcul en orbite) et les gouvernements internationaux pour Vast Satellites. Ce rôle est centré sur les marchés hors États-Unis — notamment l'Europe, le Moyen-Orient et l'Asie — et dirigera l'engagement client, le développement des opportunités, la stratégie de capture, l'engagement gouvernemental/défense et les efforts de partenariat qui font progresser les initiatives de Vast pour développer, fabriquer et exploiter des plateformes de bus satellites avancées.</p> <p>Il s'agit d'une petite équipe commerciale fondatrice de haut niveau : le rôle exige à la fois des instincts de « hunter » en développement commercial (créer des marchés et de la demande là où il n'en existe pas encore) et des compétences avérées de « closer » (négocier et exécuter des contrats allant de quelques millions à des centaines de millions de dollars).</p> <p>Ce poste sera à <strong>temps plein, exempté</strong>, ouvert à un lieu de travail international flexible comme décrit ci-dessus.</p> <p><strong>Responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Élaborer et exécuter une stratégie globale de marché commercial et gouvernemental international couvrant l'Europe, le Moyen-Orient et l'Asie, alignée sur les objectifs commerciaux de Vast.</li> <li>Établir et maintenir une veille stratégique sur le marché et la concurrence concernant les clients spatiaux commerciaux et gouvernementaux internationaux, en distinguant le positionnement de Vast de celui de ses concurrents dans chaque région.</li> <li>Piloter la planification interne pour la priorisation des opportunités internationales, la stratégie de capture et le développement du pipeline sur de multiples marchés alliés et partenaires.</li> <li>Diriger l'engagement client à travers l'identification d'opportunités, la définition du périmètre des missions, les présentations de capacités et le développement de concepts précoces avec les opérateurs commerciaux internationaux, les sociétés d'observation de la Terre, les ministères de la défense et les entités gouvernementales.</li> <li>Tirer parti d'un solide réseau préexistant de haut niveau au sein de la chaîne de valeur internationale de l'espace et de la défense pour ouvrir des portes auprès de clients potentiels et identifier précocement les menaces concurrentielles.</li> <li>Diriger l'élaboration des propositions et coordonner les contributions interfonctionnelles des équipes d'ingénierie, de gestion de programme, de finance, juridique et de contrôle des exportations/conformité, avec le soutien de l'analyste BD et de l'ingénieur avant-vente de l'équipe.</li> <li>Assumer la responsabilité du développement du pipeline, des prévisions et des rapports pour tous les comptes commerciaux et gouvernementaux internationaux.</li> <li>Négocier et conclure des contrats pour des missions commerciales et gouvernementales/défense internationales et les services associés, en naviguant à travers divers cadres nationaux de passation de marchés, de contrôle des exportations (ex. ITAR/EAR) et de partenariat.</li> <li>Se coordonner avec l'équipe de sécurité nationale de Vast lorsque les programmes internationaux croisent des parties prenantes ou des enjeux liés au gouvernement américain.</li> <li>Représenter Vast lors d'événements de l'industrie spatiale, aérospatiale et de défense internationale en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie.</li> <li>Faire des présentations, participer à des panels et fournir des briefings de haut niveau/C-suite communiquant les capacités et la valeur des plateformes satellites de Vast aux audiences commerciales, gouvernementales et de défense internationales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications Minimales :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Plus de 12 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le développement commercial spatial/aérospatial, les ventes, la gestion de capture ou les contrats gouvernementaux/défense, avec un succès avéré en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et/ou en Asie.</li> <li>Historique avéré d'origination et de conclusion personnelle de contrats, y compris des transactions de plusieurs dizaines de millions de dollars ou plus.</li> <li>Relations établies et vérifiables avec des clients potentiels au niveau cadre et exécutif, et connaissance du paysage concurrentiel sur de multiples marchés spatiaux et de défense internationaux.</li> <li>Expérience dans la chaîne de valeur spatiale/aérospatiale (lancement, bus satellite, charge utile, intégration maître d'œuvre ou opérations), idéalement complémentaire des opérations satellites — par ex. observation de la Terre ou défense internationale.</li> <li>Compréhension approfondie des structures de passation de marchés et de partenariat gouvernementales internationales pertinentes pour les programmes d'espace et de défense.</li> <li>Solides compétences techniques et capacité à communiquer des systèmes complexes à des audiences commerciales, de défense et gouvernementales internationales.</li> <li>Excellentes capacités de communication, d'analyse, de collaboration et de relations interpersonnelles ; à l'aise pour opérer à travers diverses cultures et langues.</li> <li>Capacité à opérer de manière autonome, à hiérarchiser les priorités efficacement et à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets internationaux dans un environnement de petite équipe au rythme soutenu.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences et Expériences Souhaitées :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Relations et crédibilité établies en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie.</li> <li>Maîtrise des langues pertinentes pour les marchés cibles (français, arabe, japonais, etc.).</li> <li>Expérience de travail aux côtés d'équipes d'affaires publiques locales ou coordination avec celles-ci (ex. affaires publiques gouvernementales françaises/UE).</li> <li>Connaissance des régimes de contrôle des exportations (ITAR/EAR) dans les programmes de satellites internationaux.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Exigences Supplémentaires :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Capacité à voyager plus de 50 % du temps.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Vast is looking for a&nbsp;<strong>Director, Satellite Business Development International</strong>, reporting to the <strong>SVP, Satellite Business Development &amp; Commercialization</strong>, to lead commercial (communications, Earth observation, sensing, defense, and in-orbit compute applications) and international government-focused business development for Vast Satellites. This role is focused on markets outside the United States — including Europe, the Middle East, and Asia — and will lead customer engagement, opportunity development, capture strategy, government/defense engagement, and partnership efforts that advance Vast's initiatives to develop, manufacture, and operate advanced satellite bus platforms.</p> <p>This is a small, senior founding commercial team: the role demands both business development "hunter" instincts (creating markets and demand where none exist yet) and proven "closer" skills (negotiating and executing contracts from single-digit millions to hundreds of millions of dollars).&nbsp;</p> <p>This will be a <strong>full-time, exempt</strong> position open to a flexible international location as described above.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a comprehensive international commercial and government market strategy spanning Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, aligned with Vast's business objectives.</li> <li>Build and maintain a market and competitive intelligence view across international commercial and government space customers, distinguishing Vast's positioning from competitors in each region.</li> <li>Lead internal planning for international opportunity prioritization, capture strategy, and pipeline development across multiple allied and partner markets.</li> <li>Lead customer engagement across opportunity identification, mission scoping, capability briefings, and early concept development with international commercial operators, Earth observation companies, defense ministries, and government entities.</li> <li>Leverage a strong, pre-existing senior-level network across the international space/defense value chain to open doors with potential customers and identify competitive threats early.</li> <li>Lead proposal development and coordinate cross-functional contributions from engineering, program management, finance, legal, and export-control/compliance teams, supported by the team's BD analyst and pre-sales engineer.</li> <li>Own pipeline development, forecasting, and reporting across all international commercial and government accounts.</li> <li>Negotiate and close contracts for international commercial and government/defense missions and associated services, navigating varying national procurement, export-control (e.g., ITAR/EAR), and partnership frameworks.</li> <li>Coordinate with Vast's National Security team where international programs intersect with US Government stakeholders or content.</li> <li>Represent Vast at international space, aerospace, and defense industry events across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.</li> <li>Deliver presentations, participate in panels, and provide senior/C-suite-level briefings that communicate the capabilities and value of Vast's satellite platforms to international commercial, government, and defense audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of relevant experience in space/aerospace business development, sales, capture management, or government/defense contracting, with demonstrated success operating in Europe, the Middle East, and/or Asia.</li> <li>Proven track record of personally originating and closing contracts, including deals in the tens of millions of dollars or above.</li> <li>Established, verifiable senior and executive-level relationships with potential customers, and knowledge of the competitive landscape across multiple international space/defense markets.</li> <li>Background in the space/aerospace value chain (launch, satellite bus, payload, prime integration, or operations), ideally complementary to satellite operations — e.g., Earth observation or international defense.</li> <li>Deep understanding of international government procurement and partnership structures relevant to space and defense programs.</li> <li>Strong technical understanding and ability to communicate complex systems to international commercial, defense, and government audiences.</li> <li>Excellent communication, analytical, collaboration, and interpersonal skills; comfortable operating across cultures and languages.</li> <li>Ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple international efforts simultaneously in a fast-paced, lean-team environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Skills &amp; Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Existing relationships and credibility across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.</li> <li>Fluency in languages relevant to target markets (French, Arabic, Japanese, etc.).</li> <li>Experience working alongside or coordinating with in-country government affairs teams (e.g., French/EU government affairs).</li> <li>Familiarity with export-control regimes (ITAR/EAR) in international satellite programs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to travel 50%+ of the time.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div style="font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'Segoe UI', Trebuchet MS, Tahoma, sans-serif;"> <p style="line-height: 1; font-size: 14px;"><em>We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.</em></p> <p style="line-height: 1;">&nbsp;</p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><strong>COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS<br></strong><br>Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee &amp; onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.</p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><strong><br>U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE STATUS<br><br></strong>The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by&nbsp;<a href="https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-22/section-120.62">22 C.F.R. § 120.62</a> or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. This status includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending.<br><br></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><strong>EQUAL OPPORTUNITY</strong><br><br>Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

title: Expert Assurance | Courtage & IA @Panora (backed by Hexa)
description: À propos de Panora Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures. Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si , mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre. Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers. Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk. Pourquoi ce rôle existe Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur. Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage. Vos responsabilités Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients. La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système — améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir. Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA. Quand des questions surgissent, vous apportez la crédibilité et l'expertise nécessaires pour expliquer, rassurer ou corriger. Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision. Votre profil Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47 Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nuire à un client Vous écrivez clairement et savez expliquer des concepts complexes d'assurance à des non-experts Vous êtes sincèrement curieux de ce que l'IA change pour notre secteur, enthousiaste à l'idée de le vivre de l'intérieur et d'y contribuer Vous êtes à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et attachez plus d'importance au métier de l'assurance qu'au confort de la routine Français courant ; l'anglais est un plus Ce rôle est fait pour vous si Vous avez passé des années à maîtriser l'assurance et souhaitez encoder cette expertise dans un produit qui transforme l'industrie L'idée de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur vous enthousiasme, pas seulement utiliser des outils, mais les construire Vous êtes méticuleux, rigoureux, et mettez un point d'honneur à bien faire les choses Vous aimez accompagner les clients et les aider à réussir Vous voulez rejoindre suffisamment tôt pour façonner ce que doit être le courtage assisté par IA Ce rôle n'est pas fait pour vous si Vous cherchez un poste de courtage traditionnel avec un portefeuille clients et des objectifs commerciaux Vous préférez la routine à la construction from scratch Les détails vous ennuient Ce qui rend ce rôle unique Vous rejoignez à un stade où le produit est suffisamment jeune pour que votre expertise façonne directement son intelligence Vous vérifierez et améliorerez les outputs IA en IARD, Santé, et au-delà au fil de notre expansion Vous faites partie de la boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA continuellement plus intelligente Vous vivez la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur — un point de vue rare dans le secteur Vous êtes un membre fondateur d'une équipe qui construit l'OS IA pour les courtiers européens. Cela signifie une vraie ownership, un vrai impact, et une trajectoire qui évolue avec Panora. Pourquoi nous rejoindre Responsabilité de niveau fondateur et impact direct sur le produit Votre expertise assurance devient l'intelligence du produit Une place au premier rang de la transformation IA en assurance, vue de l'intérieur Courbe d'apprentissage intense à l'intersection de l'assurance et de l'IA Package de rémunération compétitif, incluant des equity Travaillez depuis les bureaux d'Hexa aux côtés de fondateurs, d'opérateurs et d'autres startups en early stage Processus de recrutement Call intro avec l'équipe Talent d'Hexa (30 minutes) Call fit avec Diane pour comprendre votre parcours et votre expertise (30 minutes) Un scénario assurance réel : examiner une synthèse générée par l'IA, identifier les lacunes et expliquer comment vous amélioreriez l'output (à faire chez vous + restitution de 45 minutes avec Diane et Fabian) Une rencontre avec Fabien (CTO) Un entretien avec Matthieu, Partner chez Hexa Panora s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés sans distinction de genre, origine, identité, parcours ou orientation sexuelle. Nous savons qu'il reste beaucoup à faire en matière de diversité dans notre secteur, c'est pourquoi nous encourageons toutes les candidatures — en particulier celles issues de milieux sous-représentés. Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot , Polkadot SDK , and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications. About the Team Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design. About the Role As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols. Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools. Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities. ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation. Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues. Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle. If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you! About Working With Us Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! raw.description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

raw.description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

  • Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

  • Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

  • Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

  • Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

  • Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.

  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.

  • Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.
